# HumanPush

> In test. No real orders or payments run yet. An AI agent orders the work and the signature of a professional listed in a public Dutch register, through one MCP. The company pays 100% upfront. Fixed rules, the same for every profession. Every step is signed and kept in the evidence file of the order, which anyone involved can check independently.

People use https://humanpush.nl. This file is for agents and lives at https://humanpush.nl/llms.txt. Version 2026-11-19 (test version).

## Ask us

You can ask a question in plain text about how HumanPush works: POST https://humanpush.nl/api/ask with JSON {"question": "...", "language": "en"} (question 3–500 characters; language "nl" or "en", optional). No key, no login. The answer comes only from HumanPush's published rules, FAQ and this file, with sources (id, title, url, quote). It gives information, not advice or commitments, and does not answer about specific orders, people, prices or amounts. It stores no questions, answers or IP addresses. Fields: answerable, answer, language, sources, refusal ({"reason": out_of_scope | advice | commitment | amounts | personal_data | no_source | injection} or null), human_contact, disclaimer, engine. Errors: 400 bad_request, 413 too_large, 429 rate_limited, 503 ask_disabled (switched off), 503 busy. In the test version the same answers come from the MCP tool ask_humanpush. Asking is switched off until the test phase allows it. A staff member answers at info@humanpush.nl; there are no exceptions per case.

## Status

- Version 1 is in test. There is no public v1 endpoint yet. Access opens after the test phase is completed; there is no start date.
- Companies only (B2B, with a Dutch KvK number). Netherlands first.
- All amounts and time limits are test values or working rules during the test phase.
- Working hours: Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00 Europe/Amsterdam, minus Dutch public holidays; the clock is stopped outside working hours. The 72 hours for a dispute are ordinary clock hours.
- HumanPush is a trade name of HumAgent B.V. (KvK 42222476).

## The model

Company -> its AI agent -> HumanPush MCP -> a registered professional (with his own agent, or without MCP through a HumanPush agent on a simple signing screen that is coming; he signs with his passkey) -> back to the company with the signed result and the proof.

HumanPush runs the terms automatically; the evidence file of each order is the proof. If the terms, the HumanPush system and this file differ, the terms come first, then the system, then this file. No helpdesk that bends rules: a staff member answers questions at info@humanpush.nl, but there are no exceptions per case. v1_explain explains every state, reason and error code.

## The five services

One service per register. HumanPush is not part of any register and uses no register logos. list_services gives per service in_scope and out_of_scope: what is and is not part of the service.

- NIVRE (claims adjusters): an independent opinion on a claims decision, on the documents. Disclaimer: an opinion on documents only, no inspection on site; no personal injury. Registry check valid 30 days.
- NRVT (registered valuers, Kamer Wonen): a valuation report of a home, without NWWI validation. Disclaimer: not for a mortgage or NHG. Registry check valid 30 days.
- NRGD (court experts, 008.1 computer forensics): an integrity and timestamp check of one supplied document. Disclaimer: outside court proceedings; not a court expert report. Registry check valid 30 days. Opens when at least 5 experts from at least 3 organisations are available.
- Register of patent attorneys (Octrooicentrum Nederland): a novelty quick scan. Disclaimer: no filing, no freedom-to-operate advice; the company is visible to the professional for the conflict check; the content only after acceptance. Registry check at most 30 days old, and on top of that the list's reference date at most 120 days old at the check.
- NRBI (Nederlands Register Bouwkundig Inspecteurs): a remote review of an existing building inspection report. Disclaimer: no new inspection and no NRBI-validated inspection. Registry check valid 30 days.

Review criteria (a dispute may only name these; ids as in list_services):

- Every service: form_complete (all fixed parts and the agreed format), question_answered (see per service), scope_respected (see per service), disclaimer_present (the mandatory disclaimer unchanged).
- NIVRE: question_answered = the opinion answers whether the claims decision stands, with reasons; scope_respected = on documents, within the given line of business, no personal injury; plus independence_declared (the independence declaration is signed).
- NRVT: question_answered = the report is traceable: the value follows from the recorded data and method; scope_respected = Kamer Wonen, not for a mortgage or NHG, no NWWI.
- NRGD: question_answered = the report states whether the document is unchanged since the given time, with the checks used; scope_respected = one supplied document, outside court proceedings, within 008.1; plus method_ai_statement (the method and the AI statement are given).
- Patent attorneys: question_answered = the search report answers the search question within the given technical field; scope_respected = novelty only: no filing, no FTO, no amounts.
- NRBI: question_answered = the review follows the 8-point checklist and answers the questions asked (at most 3), in at most 3 pages; scope_respected = existing buildings only; no inspection, no legal advice.

list_services gives per service the exact service_id, inputs, outcomes, price range, in_scope and out_of_scope, the fixed HumanPush fee H (a fixed fee per service, the same for every company, excluding VAT, visible before you order; a change applies only to new orders), the review criteria, the disclaimer and the known gaps of the register.

## When not to use HumanPush

- For consumers.
- When you do not need a registered signer.
- The law does not always require one. GDPR art. 22 gives people a right to meaningful human intervention in certain automated decisions; the EU AI Act requires human oversight for high-risk AI systems; registration (such as NIVRE) is a professional quality standard. HumanPush offers an independent, verifiable expert assessment when the situation calls for it.
- For a valuation for a mortgage, court expert reports, patent filings or notarial deeds.
- To force a different conclusion: a dispute is only about the fixed review criteria of that service.

## Tools, in order: how your agent connects

How your agent connects: it calls list_services, then v1_create_order, pays pay_url within 30 minutes, follows the order with v1_get_status and fetches the result with v1_get_result and verify_proof. Tool names of the test version; they may change. Every write call takes an idempotency_key: the same key never runs an action twice.

1. list_services: the bookable services and the terms of the one method.
2. v1_create_order: service_id, inputs, deadline (ISO 8601) and max_price_cents. Optional: min_proof_level, to require a stricter registry check than the standard one (never a lighter one). You never name a professional; unknown fields are refused. Returns pay_url.
3. Pay pay_url within 30 minutes: max_price_cents plus H. v1_pay_link returns the open payment link again (idempotency_key required); v1_link_payment links your own payment that ended on the waiting list to your order, within the waiting time. Not paid in time: the order lapses (not_paid), nobody pays anything.
4. v1_get_status: state, reason, every deadline and the money; while the order is offered in turns also the turn, the round and the end of the current turn. Expired clocks are processed first. Poll it.
5. v1_get_result: the delivered piece, its SHA-256 and the professional's registration number.
6. verify_proof: checks the digital fingerprint, the professional's passkey signature and the evidence file.
7. v1_accept_result, or v1_object within 72 hours with grounds taken from the service's review criteria (otherwise invalid_objection).
8. v1_cancel: possible until delivery.
9. v1_explain: the fixed explanation of any state, reason or error code.
10. ask_humanpush (test version, switched off by default): a question in plain text, answered from the published rules with sources, as in "Ask us".

Professionals use v1_passkey_register (to register a passkey on their own device, and a second passkey as a reserve; without the second passkey a professional gets no turn), get_my_turns (the open turns of this professional: service, price, lead time and the end of the turn), v1_professional_status and v1_professional_act (accept, pass_turn, deliver, review). Every action of a professional is signed with his passkey. The pattern is two calls: first without an assertion, then with an assertion; the tools are in the test version and may still change. A simple signing screen with passkey login is coming for professionals without their own agent; it cannot be opened yet. The professional receives his key once, by a one-time link to a contact address HumanPush checks itself (in the register or on the firm's website), never to an address he supplies. That link only serves to fetch the key and register the passkey plus the required second passkey as a reserve; every step is signed with a passkey.

## Accepting: turns

- After payment HumanPush offers the order in turns, to one matching professional at a time, in a fixed order (lowest own price, shortest lead time, fair rotation).
- A turn lasts 45 working minutes. If the turn holder does not accept, or passes the turn (pass_turn, signed, no penalty), the turn moves at once to the next matching professional.
- After each round HumanPush builds the queue again and records it; at most 2 turns per professional per order. Every start, end and pass of a turn is in the evidence file.
- This goes on until someone accepts, or the company cancels (free before acceptance). If no matching professional can deliver on time any more, or nobody accepts within 3 working days, everything goes back.

## States

- offered: ordered, waiting for payment (30 minutes).
- funded: paid. HumanPush offers the order in turns until someone accepts (see "Accepting: turns").
- active: accepted. The difference with his lower price went back. The delivery deadline runs.
- delivered: 72 hours to accept or dispute. Silence counts as acceptance.
- review: disputed. A reviewer from the same register, matched by HumanPush, decides meets or fails.
- Waiting state after an outage (v1_explain gives its exact state name): the dispute window ended while HumanPush could not show its own service worked. A dispute is still possible for a short time; payout moves at most 5 working days.
- closed_success, closed_refund (with a reason), closed_cancelled, expired.

Reasons include not_paid, no_accept, cancelled, withdrawn, late, review_fails, returned_conflict, suspended, deregistered, no_reviewer, platform, platform_review and success. Ask v1_explain for each.

## Money

- 100% upfront, within 30 minutes: max_price_cents plus the fixed HumanPush fee H. A fixed fee per service, the same for every company, excluding VAT, visible before you order. A change applies only to new orders.
- When the professional accepts at his own lower price, the difference goes back at once.
- If nobody accepts (nobody can deliver on time any more, or 3 working days passed), everything goes back.
- Cancel before acceptance: everything back. After acceptance and before delivery: the professional keeps 25% of his fee, the rest goes back, including H. No cancelling after delivery.
- The professional withdraws or delivers late: everything back. No replacement and no extension after acceptance; you may order again.
- Conflict of interest, only for a service with a mandatory conflict check (now patent attorneys): the professional returns the order before delivery; everything back, no 25%.
- A reviewer who reports a conflict after accepting gets a mark only for a service with a mandatory conflict check (now patent attorneys); for the other services it counts as a failure.
- The register reports the professional as suspended or deregistered before delivery: everything back; he is not paid.
- Dispute: only on the fixed review criteria of that service (see above), within 72 hours. The verdict is binary: meets, or fails with a ground. Fails: everything back. There is no second round and no partial outcome.
- No reviewer found, or HumanPush cannot show its own service worked: everything back, and HumanPush pays the professional from its own reserve.
- The professional is paid after acceptance, after 72 hours without a dispute, or after meets. HumanPush keeps H only when an order succeeds.

## Proof

- Registry check: a HumanPush staff member looked the professional up in the public register with a fixed checklist; source and date are kept. At most 30 days old; for patent attorneys also the list's reference date at most 120 days old at the check. Checked again at every acceptance (for NRVT by hand, recorded). It is a registry check with a validity period, not a live link to the register. Without a valid registry check a professional gets no turn.
- A company may require a stricter registry check (min_proof_level), never a lighter one. At the start no register offers a stricter check, so that requirement finds nobody now.
- Every step of a professional or reviewer is signed with his passkey.
- Every step is in the evidence file of the order and refers to the previous one. Each delivered document gets a digital fingerprint (SHA-256): if one letter changes later, the fingerprint no longer matches. The company, the professional and an auditor can check the evidence file themselves.
